_comment: Luyện đan (spec 12.3). The fire minigame (systems/alchemy_fire.py, same file in the client): a needle sweeps the heat bar 0..100 and back; each of the 3 presses must land in the văn hỏa zone (perfect = its centre). The needle starts from 0 again after each press. period_ms: one sweep there and back, per press, by difficulty. zone_width / perfect_width in bar units, widened by the furnace level. Points: press perfect/good/miss, pinyin right/wrong (a character not learned yet is shown with its reading and skipped). Quality = the first entry whose min the share total / best possible reaches (best possible = 2 per press + 1 per character asked), so a player who has not learned the characters of a name can still brew Thượng phẩm with three perfect presses. Ingredients and the fee are spent when the fire is lit; an abandoned brew is lost.
